content:
Recently I tried several new MagSafe wallets, looking for one that looks more like a traditional wallet. The Vinich MagSafe wallet is one I've tried recently, offering more than 15 colour options, looking like a traditional bifold wallet, designed to attach to the back of a leather iPhone case, so it doesn't clash with the protective case and looks more like an extension of your iPhone case.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers will bring you the latest products in the MagSafe and wireless charging market, helping you get the most out of your wireless charging Apple devices.

Colour Options

The manufacturer has clearly put a lot of effort into colours, offering black, green, brown, and even purple, among others, all with a vintage tone that complements rather than upstages the leather case. There are many other colours to choose from as well. Vinich also offers a Desert Titanium colour, which is perfect if you use your phone naked.

Wallet Capacity

Vinich clearly states there are three card slots, and depending on card thickness, it can actually hold three to five cards. For daily use, you can put your ID card, one or two credit cards, and a company access card. Behind the cards there's also room to tuck in one or two banknotes — this is a feature I really love in small wallets — I try to carry about US$20 in cash on me.

The card slots use RFID-blocking material inside, lined with microfibre so your cards don't constantly rub against fabric. The magnet is strong enough — though I've used stronger ones, and quite a bit weaker ones too.

Three Things to Know Before Buying

First, this is synthetic leather, not real leather. It has scratch-resistant construction and reinforced stitching, which is reasonable at this price point, but if you want to match it with a real leather case, note that the two materials won't look exactly the same. Vinich recommends conditioning it every three to six months.

Second, when taking photos with the wide-angle or macro lens, the wallet may gradually creep into the frame. Most iPhone wallets hang below the lens, but if you're taking close-ups, it's best to remove it first so it completely doesn't block the lens.

Third, it doesn't function as a stand, even though it might look like it could. The cover is deliberately designed to be relatively soft so the magnetic ring isn't compressed, so if you're looking for a wallet that can prop up your iPhone for video calls or watching videos, this one isn't for you.

Summary

Priced under US$25, if you've been using a decent leather case but can't find a wallet to match it, the colour options alone are worth a look. Most MagSafe wallets aim for an "invisible" effect, but this one is designed to complement other accessories, looking and feeling more like a traditional wallet that can be used on its own. It would be perfect if Find My tracking could be added in the future.

You can buy this Vinich MagSafe wallet on Amazon or directly from the Vinich website.
